description: This file is a configuration script for ESLint, specifically tailored for a Vue.js project using TypeScript. It imports various plugins and configs, and defines an ESLint configuration using 'defineConfigWithVueTs' for linting rules, file patterns, and ignored directories.

methods.name: defineConfigWithVueTs
methods.description: Defines the ESLint configuration with Vue and TypeScript integrations, supporting multiple configuration sections for the project.
